name: tool-dashboard
description: Custom touch dashboards that return structured selections to a waiting tool.

interface.shortDescription: Use custom dashboards during a tool workflow.
interface.longDescription: Open a magazine or file tray, hold a bounded tool call, and return the user's selected state through an MCP App callback. Requires a host with MCP Apps and concurrent UI tool calls.
defaultPrompt: Let me choose and arrange a working set of files.
